drawer.label: Details
drawer.empty: Select an item to see its details.

builtBy.foundation: This page is built in the foundation, in a later sequence.
builtBy.diagnose: This page arrives with the Diagnose pillar.
builtBy.plan: This page arrives with the Plan pillar.
builtBy.operate: This page arrives with the Operate pillar.
builtBy.prove: This page arrives with the Prove pillar.

empty.noNumbers: No numbers are shown until the engine produces them.

shell.apiUnreachable: Cannot reach the platform API. Check that it is running.
shell.notAllowed: Your role may not open this page. The COO decides access.
shell.stationOnly: This screen belongs to a machine.

login.title: Sign in
login.sso: Sign in with your company account
login.ssoNote: Single sign-on with your company account (Microsoft). Your role decides your start page.
login.devNote: Pilot sign-in by email for accounts IT created. Not available in production.
login.noStations: No station logins yet. IT adds them on the Users page.
login.stationNote: The station signs in, not a person. No personal data is stored.
login.foot: EU data residency · encrypted · read-only towards your ERP
login.noTenant: This site has no plant configured. Ask IT to set CIP_TENANT_ID.
login.failed: Sign-in failed. Check the details and try again.
login.locked: This station login is off or locked. Ask IT.
login.ssoFailed: Company sign-in failed. Try again or ask IT.

users.headline: {people, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} · {stations, plural, one {# station} other {# stations}}
users.accessNote: What a role may see is set on
users.itOnly: Only IT manages logins. You can see the list.
users.errorExists: This account or station login already exists.
users.errorInput: Check the details and try again.
users.ssoOnNote: People sign in with their company account. Station logins always use a station PIN.
users.ssoOffNote: During the pilot, personal accounts use email sign-in. Station logins always use a station PIN.
users.neverStoredBody: Who stood at which station, or how fast a person worked.
users.neverStoredNote: Station logins belong to the machine. Personal accounts exist only for people who plan, decide or administer.

access.label: Access per role
access.headlineAll: Everyone can open every page. Untick to restrict, set money and plants per role, and choose who decides what.
access.headlineRestricted: {count, plural, one {# page permission} other {# page permissions}} restricted. The COO can change this at any time.
access.cooOnly: Only the COO changes access. You can see the settings.
access.lockedNote: Start pages, the COO's Access page and IT's Users page cannot be turned off.
access.hoursNote: Hours are converted by the engine: € ÷ throughput per constraint hour. Until a constraint is detected they show as missing.
access.auditNote: Every change is recorded in the audit log with who changed what and when.

question.plant_director: What does the constraint cost us?
question.planner: What do I release, in which order?

decisions.report_stop: Report a stop and its reason

plant.label: Plant
plant.noneBody: Add the plant, its stations and machines first.

import.headlineNone: Upload your ERP and MES exports. Personal columns are dropped as the file is read.
import.headlineDone: {ok} of {total} minimum items fully met. Gaps lower confidence; they are never filled in by guessing.

headline.uploaded: Files uploaded. Check how the columns map, then run the import.
headline.running: Importing… this page updates by itself.
headline.failed: The last import failed. See the reason below.

import.readOnly: Your role can see imports but not upload or run them.
import.uploadNote: Upload all files of one export together. Files stay in your tenant; employee columns are never read.
import.uploadFailed: Upload failed. Use .csv or .xlsx files with plain names.
import.noImport: No import for this plant yet.
import.rowsStored: {rows, plural, one {# row stored} other {# rows stored}}
import.failed: Import failed ({reason}). The data from before stays as it was.
import.personalNote: Personal data: dropped on import, never stored
import.missingColumns: Columns the mapping needs but the file lacks: {columns}
import.checkAfterRun: The data checklist appears after the import has run.
import.minimumLabel: Minimum to start a diagnostic · 5 exports + 1 sheet

minimum.products: Products with price and truly variable cost

import.checklistNote: Also sent to prospects before a diagnostic

setup.label: Plant setup
setup.headline: {stations, plural, one {# station} other {# stations}} · {machines, plural, one {# machine} other {# machines}}. Measured times come from the last import; ERP values are for reference.
setup.headlineEmpty: No plant yet. Enter the plant, its stations and machines at kick-off.
setup.readOnly: Your role can see the setup but not change it.
setup.errorConflict: This already exists or is still in use.
setup.errorInput: Check the details and try again.
setup.noOperations: No operations yet. They come with the routings in an import.
setup.measuredNote: Measured times replace ERP standards in every calculation. ERP values are shown for reference only.
setup.noProducts: No products yet. They come with an import.
setup.throughputNote: Throughput = sales price − truly variable cost (formula throughput_per_unit_v1), not cost-accounting margin. Calculated by the engine, never typed in.
setup.costsNote: Used later to weigh Elevate actions (overtime, extra shifts) against their gain. Empty means not known.

calendar.headline: Shifts, breaks and maintenance per machine, in plant local time ({tz}).
calendar.readOnly: Your role can see the calendar but not change it.
calendar.errorInput: Check the details and try again.
calendar.noMachines: No machines yet. Add them on Plant setup.
calendar.noWindows: Nothing on the calendar this day
calendar.dataRange: Nothing this day. The calendar has data from {from} to {to}.
calendar.coverHint: Click a break to mark it covered (the machine keeps running) or not.
calendar.noExceptions: No maintenance, holidays or overtime in the next 12 weeks.
calendar.overtimeLabel: Overtime worked per machine per week
calendar.noOvertime: No overtime entered or imported yet.
calendar.overtimeNote: Per machine and week, never per person. Can also come from an import.

connections.headlineNone: No data has come in yet. Start with a file upload on the Import page.
connections.headlineOk: The last import ran without rejected rows.
connections.headlineRejected: The last import rejected {rejected, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}. Rejected rows are reported, never guessed.

headline.uploaded: Files are uploaded but the import has not run yet.
headline.failed: The last import failed. See the Import page.

connections.rejected: {rejected, plural, one {# row rejected} other {# rows rejected}}
connections.ssoOff: Not configured · pilot uses email sign-in
connections.stationCount: {count, plural, =0 {None} one {# (belongs to a machine, no person)} other {# (one per machine, no person)}}
connections.toUsers: Manage logins on the Users page
connections.byDeployment: Set by the deployment; not verified in this environment
connections.isolationValue: Own tenant, row-level security on every table
connections.floorDataValue: None: tasks and stations only; employee columns dropped on import
connections.erpValue: Read-only: the platform never writes back
